Azure Guidelines (1)

Versioned members are deleted without modeling their removal4 affected intents

Gap: The fetched Evolving APIs guidance requires versioned removal through `@removed`. Direct deletion rewrites the already existing 2026-12-06 projection instead of recording an evolution boundary.

Expected

Use `@removed` with the version where an existing model, property, operation, or service value is removed so earlier API-version projections retain the declaration.

Guidance: Evolving APIs — Adding and removing API elements
